articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Brain Tumor Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Diagnosing a brain tumor typically necessitates the expertise of a radiologist, whose skills and knowledge are essential to the process. Since the overall number of individuals has grown, so too has the quantity of medical data required to be managed, rendering outdated methods extremely costly and inefficient. Many investigators looked into different techniques that had been quick and effective in identifying and categorizing brain tumours. Currently, Machine learning (ML) techniques have gained popularity in the development of computerized systems that can quickly and effectively diagnose or segment brain tumours. The deep learning (DL) enables the application of ML frameworks for brain tumor identification. This paper proposed various ML models to analyze the MRI images. First, preprocessing and augmentation algorithms were applied to the MRI brain images. We evaluated the performance of several models, including LR, SVC, kNN, NB, NN, RF, and K-means clustering. The analysis focused on accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC. LR (96%), NN (95%), and RF (96%) showed the highest performance across all metrics, effectively distinguishing between tumor and no-tumor images and providing reliable results.

articleTitle: Optimizing 3D Printing to Increase the Gain and Bandwidth of Microstrip Antennas: A Research on Implementation and Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: It goes without saying that Antenna design is decisive for wireless communication technology progression. As we know that Microstrip antennas, widespread for microwave frequencies, have been considered in this paper to increase their gain and bandwidth. Experiments which has been done show that raising substrate height and patch length can increase the gain and bandwidth of a rectangular microstrip patch antenna. The antenna's design and progress were made possible using 3D printing technology. The antenna's reliability and appropriateness for wireless communication technologies could momentously profit from its use. Antenna design is crucial to the advancement of wireless communication technology. The design of an antenna can significantly affect how well a wireless communication link performs. Microstrip antennas, occasionally denoted to as printed antennas, are among the many assortments of antennas that have become progressively standard due to their use in microwave frequencies. Researchers have looked into ways to increase the microstrip or patch antennas' gain and bandwidth. In order to upsurge the gain and bandwidth of a rectangular microstrip patch antenna, that is the main prominence of this work. Trials have shown that the rectangular microstrip patch antenna's bandwidth and gain may be efficaciously amplified by floating both the substrate height and the patch length. The design and development of the microstrip antenna was the first step in the multi-stage research process. Particularly, the antenna's concluding structure was made possible by the use of 3D printing technology. The printed antenna was then put through a thorough testing process using a Vector Network Analyzer at an antenna laboratory. The outcome of this extensive examination and testing shows that a microstrip antenna optimized for microwave frequencies has been developed, and it is very suited and reliable. The field of wireless communication technologies could benefit greatly from the use of this antenna.

articleTitle: Spider Wasp Optimization for Effective IoT Task Placement in Cloud-Fog Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Effective task placement algorithms in cloud-fog networks are required due to the substantial rise in data generated by the proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices. This research introduces a unique Spider Wasp Optimization (SWO)-based method for IoT task allocation that improves performance and resource usage in cloud-fog situations. The SWO method is utilized to dynamically distribute IoT workloads between cloud and fog nodes, guaranteeing optimal load distribution and low latency. It is inspired by the hunting and nesting habits of spider wasps. To evaluate the performance of the suggested method, to carry out extensive simulations and compared them with conventional optimization methods. Our findings show that SWO greatly increases network resource management, decreases total execution time, and increases task placement efficiency. This work demonstrates how bio-inspired algorithms, such as SWO, can be used to tackle challenging IoT task placement problems in cloudfog networks, opening the door to more resilient and scalable IoT ecosystems.

articleTitle: An Automated Mood Analysis of Crying Infants Through Sound Recognition Using Hybrid Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Language serves as a means for humans to communicate information and express their intentions. However, newborn babies, lacking language skills, rely on crying to communicate their needs and emotions, often leaving parents unsure of how to respond effectively. Previous research has identified various factors, such as fundamental frequencies, that correlate with different aspects of infant crying, including emotional state, health, and gender. However, traditional manual analysis methods are subjective and time-consuming. This study introduces a novel approach utilizing Hybrid Deep Learning Techniques, specifically Logistic Regression, Random Forest with Decision Tree, RNN and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), to automatically classify different emotional states expressed through infant crying. The deep learning model's architecture is meticulously designed to capture subtle acoustic nuances, enhancing its ability to predict diverse moods accurately. Ethical and privacy considerations regarding infant monitoring are also addressed, with robust security measures and privacy-preserving techniques implemented to safeguard sensitive data. The findings of this study offer insights into infant emotional needs and propose a practical and efficient automated mood analysis system for parents, caregivers, and healthcare professionals. This system has the potential to significantly contribute to creating a nurturing environment conducive to the optimal growth and well-being of newborns. The resultant accuracy has simulation obtained Random Forest and Decision Tree is 85%, RNN is 91% and CNN with LSTM is 96% giving the high accuracy.

articleTitle: Vehicle and Building Detection using Convolutional Neural Network for Drone Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Exploring advanced neural networks, our study concentrates on utilizing deep learning for precise detection of vehicles and buildings. Our aim is to devise an intelligent system capable of accurately discerning objects across diverse environments. Through extensive training on diverse datasets, we ensure the adaptability and reliability of our system across varied scenarios. Leveraging the unique capabilities of neural networks, such as feature extraction and pattern recognition, we optimize our system’s efficiency and accuracy in object detection. Our objective is to streamline usability while minimizing the requirement for sophisticated equipment like drones. By incorporating cutting-edge neural network techniques, our endeavor seeks to redefine the paradigm of object detection, offering practical solutions for urban planning, traffic management, and infrastructure monitoring. We present two models: one employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with an accuracy of 97.25%, and another based on You Only Look Once (YOLO) V5 architecture achieving 94.26% accuracy. Both models undergo extensive training on diverse datasets to enhance their proficiency in detecting ’bicycle’, ’2-wheeler’, ’3-wheeler’, ’4-wheeler’, and ’buildings’ from drone images.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Novel Microbattery using Multiphysics based on Artificial Intelligence Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: An optimized micro battery has been created and analyzed in this research article. Artificial intelligence (AI) applications require micro batteries because of their high energy density and tiny size. Small gadgets like wearables, sensors, and Internet of things devices can be powered by them. Micro Batteries: As AI technologies develop, they offer a small, dependable power source that helps energy-efficient systems function. Additionally, by integrating them with edge computing, devices can function autonomously without a continuous power supply. Additionally, micro batteries are appropriate for autonomous systems, flexible and tiny form factors, low-power sensors, wearable AI devices, and prolonged battery life. All things considered, microbatteries are essential for the creation and implementation of small, energy-efficient, and portable AI devices, meeting power needs and mobility of AI technologies.

articleTitle: Smart IoT Medication Companion
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: A medical reminder system is a computer-based program that helps individualsmanage their health by reminding them of their medications, appointments, and other health-related tasks. These systems can be used by healthcareprofessionals, caregivers, and patients themselves to improve medication adherence and reduce the risk of adverse health outcomes. A medical reminder system is a computerized software application designed to help patients and healthcare providers manage medication schedules and treatment plans. It uses a variety of methods to remind patients about medication times and dosages as well as appointments with healthcareproviders. The system can also provide educational resources and tools to help patients better understand their treatment plans. The primary objective of the system is to improve patient adherence to medication regimens, reduce the risk of medication errors, and ultimately improve health outcomes. A medical reminder system has the potential to enhance patient self- management, reduce healthcare costs, and improve overall quality of care. However, further research is needed to evaluate the system's effectiveness and impact on patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Optimized Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Model for Distributed Denial of Service Attack Detection in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The rapid expansion of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) has made them a critical component in various applications, from environmental monitoring to military surveillance. However, their inherent vulnerabilities make them prime targets for Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, that have the potential to significantly impair data integrity and network performance. This paper presents an advanced approach for DDoS detection in WSNs using an optimized Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) network. The proposed method leverages the strengths of Bi-LSTM in capturing temporal dependencies and patterns within network traffic data, providing a robust mechanism for identifying anomalous activities indicative of DDoS attacks. To enhance the detection accuracy and efficiency, introduce a novel optimization technique that fine-tunes the BiLSTM parameters, balancing the trade-offs between detection performance and computational overhead. Extensive simulations demonstrate that our optimized Bi-LSTM model significantly outperforms traditional machine learning approaches and standard LSTM configurations. The results underline the potential of this approach in fortifying WSNs against sophisticated DDoS threats, ensuring reliable and secure network operations.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition Robots for Enhanced Safety and Smart Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The prominent aspects of technological progress include current technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), computer vision (CV), and the Internet of Things (IoT) that apply to many sectors, particularly surveillance cameras, which use facial recognition in real time to enhance security. In general, security robots are the most prominent security systems that assist humans in dangerous jobs that humans cannot do. Herein, a low-cost robot prototype running on Raspberry PI 4 model B is proposed for enhanced safety and smart security. This smart robot functions to detect whether an intruder has come inside with the help of IoT and face recognition technology. The broadcasting of photos can take place with the room control through IoT. The system utilizes a facial recognition algorithm, separating authorized persons from intruders. The Multi-task Cascaded Convolutional Neural Network (MTCNN) algorithm is employed in image processing to identify and classify people with an accuracy of 90%. The IoT will notify the room control system if a stranger is detected. An interface is designed to control the robot, which is linked to Wi-Fi from a far end. If the person is recognized as a known person, then authorization is provided to them.

articleTitle: Harnessing Advanced Learning for Sarcasm Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Sarcasm in social media and in various methods of communication attracts higher attention and create profound impact even more than the customary positive and negative responses. It is necessary to propose a prototype and henceforth a fully-fledged system as a solution to detect sarcasm, to spread positive etiquette and avoid misguidance and misinformation. Unlike other text classification tasks, sarcasm detection is bit more challenging as it relies more on contextual nuances rather than actual word sentiment. The work leverages 5 learning algorithms (Logistic Regression, Multi-head Attention Encoder, Siamese Networks, BiLSTM and BiGRU) with data extracted from SARC (Self Annotated Reddit Corpus) Dataset and News Headline dataset. The models use contextual nuances, linguistic features to detect and analyze sarcasm. An analysis on how the model’s performance varies based on the nature of text data (ie. formal and informal) has been made to learn about the nuanced nature of sarcasm.

articleTitle: Future Navigation Demand Trends: Accurate Ride Request Forecasting Optimization Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: TNCs are represented by transport platforms such as Uber, Rapido, and Ola. In order to satisfy passenger requests, evaluate system efficiency, and improve service dependability, it is becoming more and more necessary to analyze large volumes of accessible information using big data technologies and sophisticated algorithms. there are number of issues facing the ride-hailing sector that affect the precision and effectiveness of the current systems. The demand for rides can be influenced by dynamic and non-linear elements including the weather, special events, and unforeseen catastrophes. Forecasting models get more difficult due to seasonality, trends, and the dynamic character of metropolitan surroundings. Moreover, privacy issues, the influence of legal changes, and data availability and quality all add to the difficulty of maximizing ride-hailing services. This study uses a trip request dataset to construct a model that uses data to predict the gap between passenger needs and driver supply in the specific time period and location. Important details in the dataset include the time of the trip booking, the pickup location, and the latitude and longitude of the drop point. Columns such as client ID, booking timestamp, pickup latitude, pickup longitude, drop latitude, and drop longitude are linked to each data point. Using a phone application, the traveler selects the origin and destination before touching the "Request Pickup" button to start a ride request in response to the inquiry, the driver grants the command. Even though the training is small in comparison to the ride-hailing sector as a whole, it is considered enough for pattern recognition. By utilizing data driven insights to more fully comprehend and tackle current issues, close the gap between rider demand and driver supply, and ultimately raise the general effectiveness and dependability of these transportation services, the study seeks to improve ride hailing systems.

articleTitle: Predicting Cyber-Attacks and Identifying Perpetrators Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The new generation of technology has experienced significant growth in recent years and is currently evolving. Instead, as technology advances, the number of crimes also rises. It will result in financial difficulties for the nation and its citizens. Cyberattacks account for the majority of reported attacks. It will target the privacy data of the people and the nation. As a result, it is challenging to determine what kind of attack would be employed, and the length of the inquiry would also rise. Numerous systems have been presented that use different machine-learning techniques to analyze and forecast threats. Consequently, we presented a methodology using machine learning algorithm KNN, SVM, Random Forest, and Gradient Boost Algorithm regression approach for identifying the assault. It determines the type of cyberattack that will be launched and how to foresee it. According to our research, the probability of a cyberattack declines as potential victims' income and educational levels rise. We believe that our suggested model will be helpful to law enforcement cybercrime units in identifying and stopping cyberattacks, increasing their efficacy in thwarting these threats. In conclusion, this study emphasizes how important machine learning is to improving the ability to detect cyberattacks and identify their perpetrators. By employing data-driven insights and advanced analytics, companies can enhance their capacity to anticipate, identify, and mitigate cyber threats, thereby fortifying their defenses in a constantly changing digital landscape. Going forward, sustaining a proactive posture against cyber adversaries and safeguarding the security of our global community that is interconnected depends critically on continuous research and machine learning the result accuracy and efficient has produced KNN is 84%, SVM is 94.6%, and Random Forest is 99.13%.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Artificial Intelligence for Health Care
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The study aims to do research analysis on AI usage in the field of health care. Technology has been in use in daily and practical life. People are able to feel its presence every single moment. Artificial Intelligence usage like tracking customers data every day based on their daily routine are normal nowadays. AI cannot be restricted to mobile phone usage alone. There are lot of emerging technologies like machine learning, deep learning, sensors etc. practically used in everyday routine. AI have intruded in people lives and they are aware its tracking. Knowing more about the AI environment, its benefits enjoyed in every sector especially in health care which is emerging sector in India provides lot of insights to the readers through review of literature and bibliometric analysis. The results shows that in the year 2020, the number of publications has increased by 67.8 percent. In the year 2021 tremendous increase of 70 percent of the articles and in the year 2022 it has been 56 percent. Hence this paper has attempted to find answers to the above research questions.

articleTitle: Cardio Care: A Predictive Model for Heart Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Heart Disease is still an epidemic global health concern, so trustworthy prediction models are vital for risk assessment and early detection. In this research, we propose a comprehensive predictive framework leveraging ensemble learning techniques alongside traditional Machine Learning (ML) models to increase forecasting of cardio disease accuracy. Utilizing a dataset sourced from Cardiovascular_Disease_Dataset, demographic, clinical, and lifestyle factors were incorporated as features. The performance of Naive Bayes (NB), AdaBoost, Support Vector Classifier (SVC) and Logistic Regression (LR) both individually and within ensemble frameworks, was evaluated using accuracy of 98% and AUROC (Area-Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve) of 99.845% as a primary metric. Our results demonstrate how effective ensemble learning strategies are in obtaining higher accuracy, precision-recall and along with AUROC curve for heart disease prediction compared to individual classifiers. This study underscores the importance of ensemble methods in improving predictive performance and contributing to enhanced clinical decision-making in cardiovascular health management.

articleTitle: Job Recommendation System Based on Candidate Skills
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In the constantly changing field of talent acquisition, this research presents a novel approach that improves job matching procedures by combining knowledge from the Big Five personality evaluation model with cutting edge resume keyword analysis. Through the utilisation of sophisticated resume parsing algorithms and the integration of the Big Five traits, the suggested algorithm seeks to provide recruiters with detailed candidate profiles, ultimately increasing the accuracy and efficiency of the hiring process. This research aims to provide organizations with a strong solution to improve their recruitment tactics through rigorous testing and validation covering many real-world recruitment scenarios across sectors and job roles. This integrated strategy seeks to promote better candidate-role alignment by matching applicant qualities to specific job requirements and corporate culture. This could lead to increased employee satisfaction, lower attrition, and improved organizational performance. This program is a major step in developing more sophisticated and inclusive hiring procedures, which will eventually foster richer worker dynamics and long-term organizational success.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Preserving Patient Health Record in IoT Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: As artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things (IoT), and next-generation mobile communication continue to evolve at a rapid pace, an increasingly popular application called the Internet of Medical Things (IoT) has arisen to provide ease and practicality in healthcare. Nonetheless, privacy preservation issues are brought up by accessing patient medical information inside the IoT framework, which calls for the creation of safe and private-preserving solutions. To address these issues, we provide in this study an IoT-Framework for preserving patient health record (FFPPHR) based on ELGamal blind signatures. We provide an enhanced privacy protection medical record searching technique (FFPPHR) based on the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem (ECDLP) and point out security vulnerabilities in the current FFPPHR. Our security research shows that by utilizing the hard problem assumption of ECDLP, the FPMR guarantees identity privacy and accuracy. Furthermore, the use of Blind ECDSA Signatures improves data security. Performance assessments confirm the FFPPHR efficiency, and theoretical findings agree with simulations. The suggested FFPPHR approach yields lower time costs when compared to state-of-the-art techniques, which makes it a potential option for safe and effective medical record searches in IoT contexts.

articleTitle: Multilingual Sentiment Analysis for YouTube Educational Videos Using NLP And Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has emerged as a critical method for measuring the usefulness of YouTube educational videos in the ever-expanding ecosystem of online educational content. The goal of this project is to create a multilingual sentiment evaluation framework that analyzes and discerns the emotional tenor and attitudes depicted in these movies using machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) techniques. This work intends to provide educators, content providers, and learners with essential insights into the emotional impact of educational materials by constructing a sophisticated model capable of interpreting sentiment across many languages. By using this innovative strategy, we seek to raise the standard of online instruction and create an environment that promotes engaging and successful learning across language and cultural barriers.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Decision-Tree and ANN Learning Model for Air Contamination Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Development of urban intelligent cities introduces a severe rise in environmental pollution, ranging from air and water pollution to noise pollution. Explicitly, the upsurge in deforestation, industrialization, production, and automobile activities presents increased air pollution. To recommend a suitable preventive method, a proper forecasting model is required. Presently, (ML) machine learning methods aid intelligent data evaluation and are employed in many domains. This study examines the forecasting of air contamination employing distinct ML methods. A hybrid decision-tree and (ANN) artificial neural network model is recommended for proper gauging. The analyses reports reveal that the suggested model outclasses other classical algorithms in terms of accuracy. Precisely, the presented model realized 99% and 99.88% accuracy and precision, with 99% and 99.88% sensitivity and specificity.

articleTitle: Unveiling Anomalies: A Review of Anomaly Detection Through Lens of Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In today’s transitional world, anomaly detection (AD) has made itself a major foothold application that spans across multiple domains, specifically in domains where detecting abnormal behavior or events is of paramount importance. The onset of deep learning techniques brings along with it a surge in the advancement of anomaly detection methods with the capability to handle complex and high-dimensional data. However, with these advancements, a major concern is in the explainability of these approaches - to overcome the ‘black box’ nature of these approaches. This review paper provides a detailed exploratory overview of recent advancements in AD techniques, concentrating on how and where these fall in the domain of explainable AI. Key insights from the surveyed literature include the importance of interpretability in AD systems, the versatility of deep learning architectures for AD tasks, and the emerging trends of graph-based AD using deep learning techniques. The review also discusses evaluation metrics, challenges, and future directions in the field, providing researchers and practitioners with valuable insights for advancing AD research and applications.

articleTitle: Monopole Elliptical Antenna with Double Triangular Slits for Ku Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In this paper, a Monopole elliptical antenna with double triangular slits (MEDTS) is designed for Ku band applications is presented. The proposed structure contains an elliptical patch with double triangular slits. Here, the elliptical ring has double triangular slits which was created to increase the gain and partial ground for bandwidth enhancement and good radiation characteristics. The total antenna volume is formulated on FR4 substrate with overall size of 21×25×1.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The designed antenna resonates at a frequency of 12.6GHz with an impedance bandwidth of 15.75% (11.21-13.21) GHz. This structure is suitable for Ku band applications especially for fixed satellite services and broadcasting applications. Proposed antenna was simulated by using the CST Microwave studio software.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of optimization of task scheduling algorithms for IOT applications in a Combined Environment of Cloud, Fog and Edge
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Optimising the use of resources in data centres requires effective task scheduling on the cloud. As 5G and IoT applications proliferated and produced a vast amount of jobs with strict latency requirements, it became even more difficult. The mid-layer(fog), a layer that complements cloud computing, is born out of this. Because network processing is done closer to end devices and users in fog computing, task latency can be decreased. However, because there aren’t enough resources available, not all the jobs can be scheduled in the fog. Better quality of service can only be attained by using specifically created and fine-tuned scheduling algorithms, as conventional scheduling algorithms frequently fall short in utilising the diverse resources. This research delves into a wide range of aspects about the most recent work scheduling algorithms used in cloud and fog environments. In this study, we are going to analyse various scheduling algothims based on optimization methods Constraints such as energy efficiency, time efficiency and cost efficiency based scheduling. In contrast to a packages of jobs and resources, a larger percentage of tasks are autonomous, and the majority of scheduling algorithms have been found to be dynamic and non- preemptive in nature. From this study various scheduling objectives are derived based on Quality metrics such as makespan, resource utilization, delay, load balancing, and energy consumption.

articleTitle: IoT Based Satellite Balloon System for Live-Weather Forecast
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Nowadays, looking into the world’s environmental crisis in real-time is essential. Forecasting climatic conditions is critical to human survival; it includes collecting data on the temporal dynamics of weather changes. Weather monitoring often includes monitoring emissions of major pollutants such as hydrocarbons, which are organic compounds composed of hydrogen and carbon. Prolonged exposure to hydrocarbons and other gases results in health problems such as cancer and asthma. This project aims to create an effective solution for real- time weather forecasts and air pollution control by leveraging advancements in embedded system design to create a weather monitoring system. With IoT, tracking weather parameters in a location through DHT11, Ultrasonic sensor, MQ6, MQ2, and MQ135 gas sensors is possible. Dirigible satellite monitors weather changes like temperature, humidity, and air pollution, which measures LPG gas, smoke, benzene, and other combustible gases. The data uploaded to the web page is easily accessible from anywhere in the world. This project contributes to developing a comprehensive solution for weather monitoring and air pollution control by integrating advanced embedded systems and IoT technologies.

articleTitle: Prediction of Breast cancer survivability using semi supervised machine learning framework
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) algorithms are gaining acceptance in the field of health care analytics due to their effectiveness in terms of precision and prediction accuracy. A semi-supervised machine learning framework is proposed in this paper that is based on cluster-and-then-classify approach. The sole purpose of this approach is to enhance the accuracy of breast cancer survivability prediction. Stochastic optimization algorithm has been used for optimal feature selection. Famous standalone clustering algorithms have been implemented in the framework followed by classification step. The clustered output acts as an expert view and can be used in the classification process thereby optimizing the model’s performance. The experiments show that blending of clustering results with the optimal features better train most of the standalone supervised machine learning classifiers. Based on the analysis, it is endorsed that compared to the existing cutting-edge ML techniques, the proposed framework using cluster-and-then-classify approach has resulted better performance. The logarithmic – loss has been recorded as low as in the range of [0.9.99E-16 – 0.85]. The area under the ROC curve (ROC-AUC) has been increased up to the range of [0.99 - 1.0]. The prediction accuracy has been enhanced up to the range of [96% -100%].

articleTitle: Monthly Rainfall Analysis in Southern Parts of India Using Machine Learning and Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Rainfall analysis has a vital function for raising awareness of the dangers of excessive rainfall and for boosting the travel and tourism sector, agriculture, and food security in southern India. Because rainfall is influenced by many different causes, it is challenging to forecast. In this research work, four different machine learning techniques are used: Naïve Bayes, KNN, SVM, and LR, and the accuracy for each model is determined. To improve the accuracy of each model, three different ensemble learning techniques are employed: Stacking, Bagging, and Voting Classifier, to analyze the rainfall data in southern parts of India. Given that Bagging attains the maximum accuracy of 99.5%, it is proposed that Bagging is the best model. The study shows that the ensemble model can enhance prediction quality and boost forecasting accuracy in meteorological applications by replacing traditional forecasting instruments.

articleTitle: Developing an Advanced Skin Disease Detection System by Integrating Hybrid Neural Network with Yolo V8 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Skin conditions that are caused by viruses, allergies, and fungi are common all over the world. Although sophisticated technologies such as lasers provide accurate diagnosis, their high price points restrict accessibility. Image processing makes automated dermatology screening possible in order to address this. After features are classified using multiclass SVM, users are given comprehensive illness information. This technique remarkably achieves 100 percent accuracy in identifying three different skin conditions. When used with morphology-based segmentation, image segmentation methods like adaptive thresholding and K-means clustering are very helpful in identifying diseases. This model attempts to accurately detect and analyze skin illnesses in spite of obstacles such as low lesion-to-skin contrast and visu.al similarities between diseased and non-diseased areas. Through the application of filters to reduce noise and the conversion of images to grayscale for improved processing, it offers significant diagnostic evidence, supporting doctors in their decision-making and reducing the possibility of adverse effects.

Author Keywords: Deep learning for skin lesions detection

articleTitle: A Quasi-Z-Source Boost DC–DC Converter Coupled Inductor for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The fundamental challenge of this study is to present a new quasi-Z-source boost DC-DC converter with the reduced voltage stress between switches for use in photovoltaic applications. Applications for renewable energy are taken into consideration when designing the presented converter because of its many significant benefits and unique characteristics. Additionally, the converter offers more freedom in controlling output voltage due to its greater duty cycle control range. To help restore the energy stored in the leaking inductor, a switched-capacitor with an inbuilt passive clamp circuit is included. Furthermore, the converter should have high voltage gain with a low coupled inductor turns ratio, and an variable extensive range of voltage gain. This reduces voltage spikes during turn-off. The suggested DC-DC converter's operating modes and mathematical modelling are described in this paper. The suggested new quasi-Z-source boost DC-DC converter is validated using PSIM simulation tool at various duty cycles.

articleTitle: Transformer-based Approach for Predicting Student Admission Category in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Deep learning methods are increasingly being utilized in the field of education, particularly in the process of choosing candidates for advanced degree programs. Conventional approaches frequently rely on fundamental statistical methods or uncomplicated learning models that cannot fully grasp intricate patterns in the data. This research suggests a brand-new Transformer-based technique for forecasting student admission outcomes for courses taken after graduation. Using self-attention processes, transformers have shown impressive performance in a number of natural language processing tasks, efficiently capturing long-range links. To leverage its sequential data processing capabilities, we design the Transformer based model to manage the intricacy of student admission prediction tasks. Our approach incorporates structured data sources from extracurricular activities and test outcomes. Compared to baseline methods, the Transformer-based model performs better and more accurately detects minute patterns in the data. The recommended model is tested using a real-time dataset that is generated throughout the admissions process.

articleTitle: Gamma Z Source Multilevel Inverter for Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) systems are in trend due to the enormous development in the field of Power Electronics and PV panel manufacturing technology. There are many topologies of inverter proposed, to operate the PV panel more efficiently and extract the available power from the sun. Gamma Z Source Inverter and Multilevel inverter are two separate families of inverters which are tradionally used for PV systems due to their advantages. In this paper we have carefully combined both the inverters without loosing the advantages of both the inverters. The modulation ratio of the proposed inverter is high, which thereby increases the voltage gain, and reduce voltage stress on the switches. An Enhanced Pulse Width Modulation Technique is adopted to control the switches, which is integrated to a Perturb and Observe based MPPT module. Both simulation and experimental verification of the proposed system was done and the results are found to be satisfactory.

articleTitle: A Unified Approach for Detecting Emotions through Sentimental and Emotional Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In the era of the Internet, social networking sites are becoming indispensable resources for individuals to share their feelings due to their rapid growth. Many Individuals utilize text, images, audio, and videos to share their opinions or thoughts. But using Web-based networking platforms for text conversations could be a bit too much for you to handle. Massive volumes of unorganized information are produced by social media platforms each second on the web. As soon as data is generated, it needs to be analysed to comprehend human psychology. Sentiment analysis can assist with this since it can identify polarity in texts. It assesses the author's viewpoint whether favourable, unfavourable, or neutral about a thing, people, organization, or place. In some applications, sentiment analysis might not be enough; in these situations, emotion detection which precisely evaluates an individual's emotional and mental state is required. Sentiment comprehension study includes information about several emotion models, analysis levels, and the procedures for sentiment analysis and textual emotion identification. This paper's conclusion discusses the difficulties associated with sentiment and emotion analysis.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Efficiency of Pb-Based Perovskite Solar Cells Using Layer Thickness Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) offer a promising path towards efficient renewable energy generation. This study examines the implications of strategic layer thickness control on Pb-based PSCs' efficiency using simulators. The structure of the design contains four layers: FTO (front contact), ZnO (electron-transport layer), CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>PBI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (perovskite absorber), and CuI (hole-transport layer). Each layer's thickness was diligently impacted, and its impact on crucial metrics consisting of short-circuit current density (Jsc), open-circuit voltage (Voc), fill factor (FF), and overall efficiency was assessed. Simulations found an ideal thickness of 1000 nm for the absorber layer, attaining a maximum efficiency of 24.41%. Interestingly, increasing the ZnO thickness beyond 80 nm was deleterious, whereas FTO and CuI thicknesses (100-1000 nm) showed negligible impact. Also, simulations demonstrated a temperature-dependent efficiency drop due to reduced Voc at higher temperatures. These results stress the need for accurate layer thickness management to enhance Pb-based PSC efficiency.

articleTitle: The Impact of Devops on Software Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: With an association of principles created to improve collaboration amidst the operations and development teams, DevOps offers few agile practices. The paper’s main goal is to conduct research about how the practices in Devops have affected the quality of software. The secondary objective is to identify practical means of improving quality. A literature review has been conducted to know more about the Devops practices in the industry. Five hypotheses and two case studies were derived from the literature review, which guided the creation of the conceptual study model. Research objectives were met by evaluating case studies and hypotheses using Pearson correlation. Qualitative data was collected through interviews with DevOps and quality assurance specialists; quantitative data was collected using an online survey.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of BIST logic for High Speed and Energy Efficient Carry Select Adder(CSLA)
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This paper investigates the implementation of Built-In Self-Testing (BIST) techniques tailored specifically for high-speed and energy-efficient Carry Select Adders (CSLA). The study proposes a novel CSLA design dominated by carry generation logic, aiming to optimize performance while minimizing power consumption and chip area. By integrating BIST circuitry into the CSLA architecture, the research contributes to enhancing fault detection and ensuring system integrity in high-speed computing applications. The proposed CSLA design employs carry generation logic to improve computational efficiency while mitigating power consumption and propagation delay. Through simulation using Xilinx Vivado, the study evaluates the effectiveness of the integrated BIST circuit in detecting and diagnosing faults within the CSLA. The results demonstrate the practical viability of the BIST-enhanced CSLA design in maintaining arithmetic computation integrity and reliability in high-speed computing environments. This research underscores the importance of integrating BIST techniques into CSLA designs to enhance fault detection and diagnosis capabilities, thereby improving overall system reliability and performance. The findings offer valuable insights into the implementation of BIST methodologies in high-speed and energy-efficient computing architectures, with implications for enhancing fault tolerance and system robustness in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Translation with Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This article examines the advantages of engaging in conflictual discourse as a means to address and transform image-related issues in a revolutionary manner. Unlike earlier approaches that necessitated human customization for particular applications, Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (cGANs) automatically produce image outputs and negative impacts. Picture painting, object reconstruction from edge maps, and picture combining from a label map are just a few activities that may be executed using a unified framework. The notion has been tested and proven to work in various ways it doesn’t need to be compared to other standards in any way to be implemented or embraced, many people on the internet, including artists, have played around with Pix2pix and its related apps since it was first released, making it more flexible and easier to use. As a major step forward in traditional image interpretation, this study eliminates the need for human map generation. So, there’s no requirement for overlapping sessions devoted to particular objectives the community can get satisfactory answers for various image interpretation issues in this way.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Weather Parameters Using MEMS Technology with Suitable Characteristics for Integration into a Single Chip for Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This study designs and simulates weather parameters using MEMS technology with suitable characteristics for integration into a single chip for environment monitoring. The sensing and heating filament of the temperature sensor was designed using a thin film platinum resistor, examining its ability to experience stability, increase in resistivity, accuracy, and free-contamination. The temperature sensing and heating element are based on platinum RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector) with meander shape and aluminum as the bonding pad connecting the sensor to the external circuit. A capacitive humidity sensor is implemented in consolidation with a piezoresistive pressure sensor with a square membrane. The capacitive humidity sensor with hole pattern at the upper plate and a polyimide serves as water absorbent sandwiched between the electrodes. The simulation analysis was conducted using finite element analysis in COMSOL Multiphysics version 6.0 . It was observed that the temperature increases from -100oC to - 20oC, and 10oC to 50oC respectively as a result of deviation in relative humidity in the troposphere, and atmosphere. The average changes in capacitances were found at 0.0713/%RH, while the pressure was examined to vary from 1050hPa to 5hPa in a step of 200hPa with a sensitivity of 11.50mv/bar.

articleTitle: Surveillance Robots for Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Nowadays, robots play an important part in our daily lives, decreasing human effort and error. Robots can be operated manually and automatically based on the requirement. This work's primary goal is to build and create a new robot that can conduct domestic surveillance. This robot can move around the area, gather information from the surrounding environment both visual and auditory and relay it to the user. The Internet of Things (IoT) enables control of the robot from a laptop or smartphone, and the wireless camera allows for daytime and nighttime live video streaming. Robot uses an Arduino microcontroller, an ultrasonic sensor, and an infrared sensor to gather data and transmit it to the microcontroller, which then regulates the robot's actions. Using object and motion detection, the user can identify the presence of people and objects in addition to the live streamed video output. This information provides a reliable surveillance activities. Further, this work may be applicable in defence areas to provide secret surveillance.

articleTitle: Molecular Docking Studies of Pisonia Grandis against Herpes Simplex Virus: Insights from Computational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Pisonia grandis, a member of the Nyctaginaceae family, commonly known as Leechai kottai keerai, Muruval, and Chandu, holds significant medicinal value. This plant is recognized for its abundance in alkaloids, phenolic compounds, flavonoids, coumarins, and polypeptides. Our research focused on the phytochemical properties of methanol extracts derived from its leaves. Using bioinformatics tools, we conducted molecular docking studies of these bioactive components with proteins associated with herpes virus and liver cancer. Phytochemical analysis of the leaf extract indicated the presence of flavonoids, phenolic compounds and alkaloids. Results indicate that compounds within the leaf extracts exhibit strong binding affinity towards the protein receptors, suggesting potential therapeutic implications.

articleTitle: Live Video Stream Analysis in Real-Time Using Edge Enhanced Clouds
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: With the rise in streaming data production thanks to the increasing use of Internet of Things (IOT) tools like sensors and video cameras, certain applications such as video surveillance, augmented reality, and autonomous vehicles need quick responses and speedy analysis of data. Right now, they rely on cloud-based setups to store and run machine learning analytics on the information they have. But, this centralized method doesn't fully support analyzing real-time, large-scale streaming data due to issues like network bandwidth and delays between the data source and cloud. In proposed system we have two phases such as filtration and identification. In filtration, all the low value stream objects are filtered using configuration rule which reduces the amount of data. In identification, analytics are performed in the stream of interest using deep learning inference. An algorithm is utilized to group both in-transit and cloud resources strategically in order to meet the quality of service (QOS) constraints set by the user. The study reveals that when dealing with 15k data stream elements at a frame rate ranging from 10 to 100 per second, the time required completing a task in the proposed system is at least 45% quicker and conserves more than 95% of bandwidth compared to a cloud-based approach.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Optimization: Revolutionizing 6G Networks for Efficiency and Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This paper investigates the efficiency and performance gains that may be realized by integrating AI into 6G networks. In addition to covering power distribution, channel estimations, and security in 5G and 6G, it looks at the synergies between AI algorithms, machine learning models, and new communication technologies. The study covers AI-based channel estimation, DL models for cell-free networks, and deep reinforcement learning for beam training. It focusses on the shift from 5G to 6G, spotlighting innovations such as meta-surfaces and phased antenna arrays. All things considered, the study shows how important AI will be in building intelligent, flexible, and responsive mobile networks in the future.

articleTitle: An analysis comparing CT and X-ray images for COVID-19 identification employing deep learning and image processing methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis of deep learning approaches for the identification of COVID-19 pneumonia in medical imaging, specifically focusing on CT and X-ray modalities. To aid healthcare professionals in quickly identifying infected individuals during the COVID-19 pandemic, accurate and efficient diagnostic tools are urgently required. In order to identify COVID-19 more quickly and accurately, deep learning algorithms combined with medical imaging data produced results. Computed Tomography (CT) and X-ray imaging are commonly used modalities for assessing lung involvement in COVID-19 patients, each offering unique advantages and challenges. Leveraging deep learning techniques, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), this analyzes the performance of models trained on large datasets of labeled CT and X-ray images. Our analysis includes preprocessing methods, model architectures, training procedures, and evaluation metrics to assess the efficacy of these approaches. Furthermore, this discusses the clinical implications, challenges, and ethical considerations associated with integrating deep learning-based diagnostic tools into routine clinical practice.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Uncertainties in Energy Management of a Grid Connected Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Due to increase in load demand, the urge to shift to clean energy generation to mitigate climate change necessitates for the incorporation of renewable energy sources along with dispatchable sources to form a microgrid (MG). This article illustrates the method of handling uncertainties for optimal energy management of the MG. From the results it is evident that the stochastic optimization based on scenario generation outperforms than the deterministic optimization. The test system under consideration is an IEEE-33 bus system. The uncertain behavior of PV and wind was modeled using the beta and Weibull distributions, respectively. To reduce the stress on the algorithm, 100 scenarios were generated using MCS-based scenario generation and then reduced to 10 scenarios using K-means clustering.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Convolution Neural Networks on Medical Image-Based COVID-19 Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has spurred a dire need for efficient and accurate diagnostic tools to combat the spread of the virus. Medical imaging, particularly chest X-rays and computed tomography (CT) scans, has emerged as a vital component in the diagnosis and monitoring of COVID-19-related lung abnormalities. An effective method is presented in this paper for identifying COVID-19 and distinguishing it from normal X-rays and viral pneumonia cases using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). An assessment of three CNN models (EfcientNetB0, VGG16, and InceptionV3) is performed using transfer learning methods. The most common deep learning algorithms used in this study are convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Performance measures (accuracy, recall, specificity, precision, and F1 scores) and deep learning approaches are used in this work. With an overall accuracy of 96.27% and a sensitivity of 95.63% for COVID-19, the findings demonstrate that the suggested technique generated a high-quality model. Effective detection and screening procedures may be facilitated by implementing computer vision design, as demonstrated by the study.

articleTitle: Indian Currency Classification for visually impaired people using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Currency classification is extremely difficult for visually impaired people since they must constantly seek assistance from others. Also, it appears that not everyone will support them honestly; some may take advantage of them. Currency classification models will greatly assist visually impaired people in becoming self-sufficient in classifying currencies, eliminating the need for them to seek assistance from others and avoiding being misled. To do this, a deep learning model that classifies Indian currencies based on photographs of the currency was developed . Variety of deep learning models were experimented and maximum accuracy of 80% was achieved.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach of CNN & RNN for Breast Cancer Detection and Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Breast cancer is a serious worldwide health concern, and advanced diagnostic tools are needed for an accurate and timely identification of the illness. In order to classify breast cancer through ultrasound pictures, this method suggests a hybrid strategy that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). CNN integration makes it possible to extract spatial data from ultrasound pictures and identify complex patterns that may be signs of cancer. Concurrently, RNNs are used to record temporal relationships between successive ultrasound frames, which enables the model to identify changing features of possible anomalies. By combining the advantages of both CNNs & RNNs, the suggested hybrid architecture improves the model's capacity to identify minute, dynamic patterns that are essential for precise diagnosis. In comparison to standalone CNN or RNN models, the hybrid model performs better in classification, as evidenced by experimental assessments carried out on a variety of ultrasound picture datasets. The findings highlight the hybrid approach's potential to improve breast cancer diagnostic skills and present a viable path for raising the precision and dependability of ultrasound-based tumour classification techniques.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Foliar Diseases in Apple Plants Using an Assembled CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The apple industry faces significant economic losses due to diseases and pests, contributing to low productivity levels. Detecting apple diseases promptly is essential for controlling their spread and improving overall productivity. However, early identification and diagnosis of these diseases are challenging due to various factors. In this work, we evaluated the performance of three distinct models: a custom CNN, Xception, and Resnet152V2. These models were tested on an expert-annotated dataset of apple diseases, comprising approximately 1821 high-quality RGB images across different categories of following types: C1: scab affected apple, C2: cedar apple affected by rust, C3: diseases of complex nature, and C4 samples of healthy apples. The custom CNN based proposed model trained for 50 epochs could yield an approximate accuracy of around 95%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Data Storage in Electronic Voting Machine using Blockchain System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Despite the purported benefits of electronic balloting projects, the widespread adoption of electronic voting techniques and procedures is taking longer than expected. A variety of economic, cultural, and technological barriers restrict the development and implementation of electronic polling. Despite this, there is still a substantial challenge to be overcome in terms of analysing and harmonizing electronic elections under multiple legislative and regulatory regimes. Today, web-based voting is growing increasingly popular. It has a strong potential of reducing administrative costs and increasing voter registration. Voters can cast their ballots from any location with access to the Internet, eliminating the need to print ballots or construct voting centres. Despite the benefits, online voting systems are viewed with caution since they pose unexpected risks. With only one vulnerability, significant vote manipulation is feasible. When used in voting, digital ballot devices must be reliable, accurate, secure, and user-friendly.

articleTitle: Reduced Switch Inductor DC-DC Converter with Increased Gain for PV System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: A Reduced Switch Inductor High Gain Dc-Dc Converter RSI-HGDC for PV system is provided in this paper. This converter comprises of a reduced switch inductor dc to dc converter with inductor circuit, which decreases the voltage stress and enhance voltage gain of the main switch. Reduced number of switches are employed in this proposed converter, which enhances the efficiency and decreases the switching losses of the converter. In order to maintain the output voltage regulation and runs the converter within its safe limits an MPPT control algorithm is described. The proposed converter may also achieve a low input current ripple, high voltage gains and high efficiency for a broad variety of applications including PV systems that need minimal number of components and high voltage gains. The results of the designed converter are examined by simulation as well as in experiment.

articleTitle: Enhanced Real-Time Abnormal Event Detection in Video Surveillance for Safety and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Surveillance technology is one of the important and critical tools that is used for maintaining security and safety across various situations such as public places, transportation hubs, industrial facilities, and especially smart city infrastructure. However, the sheer volume of visual data generated poses a significant challenge in monitoring and analyzing this information effectively. In this rapidly evolving landscape of surveillance technology, the need for effective abnormal event detection. This paper presents a comprehensive exploration and implementation of abnormal event detection techniques in real-time video monitoring scenarios. Leveraging recent advancements in deep learning and machine learning methodologies, a novel architecture comprising spatial and temporal encoders-decoders, alongside a binary classifier, is proposed. The architecture aims to discern abnormal events from normal activities in surveillance videos by encoding spatial and temporal features and classifying frames as normal or abnormal and cross-entropy loss. The study conducts a mathematical analysis of the proposed framework and discusses its implementation using real-time video data. Furthermore, the paper critically examines related works, emphasizing recent advancements in deep learning-based approaches, unsupervised learning, attention mechanisms, and multimodal fusion techniques in abnormal event detection. The conclusions drawn from this research highlight the potential and challenges in deploying such systems for enhanced security and safety across diverse domains.

articleTitle: Smartwatch-Powered Vehicle Navigation On Unmapped Terrain
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The progress in wearable technology and the integration of machine learning have ushered in exciting prospects for the incorporation of smartwatches as input devices in diverse fields. This paper introduces an innovative user interface tailored for recognizing input commands within the specific context of an automotive environment. The primary objective of this interface is to harness the human body as the interaction platform, steering clear of any additional elements that could potentially distract the driver's attention. The chosen interaction surface is the lap, a nearly flat area that enables users to engage with it in a manner akin to using a touchpad. The experimental results underscored the viability of the proposed technique, showcasing a test accuracy of 94%.

articleTitle: Gender Fairness Analysis in LLMs using Zero-Shot and Few-Shot Experiments
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This research delves into the critical domain of fairness analysis for various prominent large language models (LLMs). The proposed work aims to establish a comprehensive fairness analysis in the gender domain for six models, namely, GPT 3.5, Gemini, Gemini-Flash, Llama 2, Llama 3 and Gemma. This research focuses on evaluating gender biases using zero-shot and few-shot experiments on a dataset covering generalized sentences based on day-to-day instances and conversations. The few shot experiments, furthermore, help us understand how these models respond to instructions and system prompting. The motivation behind this investigation arises from escalating ethical concerns associated with biases and potential discrimination in the outputs generated by these LLMs. The findings and insights gained from this research will have direct implications for real-world applications. By highlighting potential biases, the research directly contributes to the ongoing AI development.

articleTitle: Efficient Net Approach for Skin Cancer Detection for Early Intervention
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Skin cancer is a common disease that can be fatal, and in order to effectively treat it, early discovery is essential. It is essential to treat skin cancer as soon as possible to stop its spread and any potentially fatal effects. Deep learning methods have recently demonstrated potential to enhance medical image processing, especially in the dermatology domain. This work employs the EfficientNet approach to automatically identify skin cancer from dermatoscopic pictures. EfficientNet algorithm have the potential to increase diagnosis speed and accuracy, resulting in early detection and treatment. This design is very resource-efficient and performs well because of the adoption of a compound scaling technique, which optimizes the exact depth, exact width, and resolution about the model. The objective of the study is to determine how to enhance skin cancer categorization and detection using EfficientNet. The proposed method utilises a dataset containing a range of dermatoscopic images containing both benign and malignant skin diseases. To ensure a realistic distribution of examples, the dataset has been carefully chosen, which enhances the model’s capacity to generalise to actual scenarios. The methodology consists of preprocessing the dermatoscopic pictures, optimizing the EfficientNet model that has been trained on the skin cancer dataset, and expanding the training dataset using data augmentation methods. Sensitivity, specificity, and overall accuracy are used to assess the trained model’s performance using an updated test set.

articleTitle: Analysis of Nine Level Single-Phase Cascaded H-Bridge Inverters for EVs
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This paper explores the design and operation of a Modular Nine-Level Inverter (MLI)-Electric Vehicle (EV) charging system, incorporating solar energy to power domestic loads and charge EVs. The system comprises a solar panel, DC-DC regulator, and MLI for efficient energy conversion. The MLI's modular design reduces complexity and enhances efficiency. Equivalent circuits illustrate voltage level generation, while PWM control regulates power device switching for precise output control. Performance metrics, including regulated DC supply voltage and staircase nine-level output voltage, demonstrate the system's capability for diverse applications. A nearly sinusoidal current waveform and harmonic analysis underscore the system's effectiveness in delivering stable power with reduced harmonic distortion. Comparisons between filtered and unfiltered output highlight the importance of filtering techniques in improving power quality. Overall, the MLI-EV charging system showcases advancements in renewable energy integration, offering a versatile solution for sustainable electricity generation and EV charging.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Frequency Response in Integrated Power System Using Power Electronics Controller Tuned With Whale Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The performance of any isolated hybrid power system is characterized by the type of controller being used. The considered power generating units are the solar thermal power plant (STPP), wind turbine generator (WTG), and diesel engine generator (DEG), whose frequency stabilization has been done with the utilization of proportional-integral-derivative (PID), integral-tilt-derivative (I-TD), and tilt-integral-derivative (TID) controllers. Tuning controller gains using the whale optimization algorithm (WOA) and the quasi-oppositional based whale optimization algorithm (QOWOA) involves optimizing the parameters to achieve the best performance for a given hybrid system. A comparative frequency response of the system under the individual influence of PID, TID, and I-TD controllers has been shown with different types of load perturbations. The simulation result shows that QOWOA-TID outperforms the other controllers. The study addresses the critical need for optimizing control strategies in hybrid power systems to ensure stability, efficiency, and reliability, thereby contributing to the advancement of sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: U-Net based Pancreas Segmentation from Computed Tomography Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Delineation of pancreas from computed tomography (CT) scan images is burdensome owing to its anatomic variation in size, shape and its presence with respect to adjacent organs. This work explores the U-Net architecture to delineate pancreas from the CT volume of abdomen. U-Net was trained for variable number of epochs to identify the optimal learning environment for better segmentation performance. U-Net when trained for pancreas segmentation using CT dataset taken from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) has resulted in a segmentation performance of dice similarity coefficient of 0.8138, intersection over union of 0.7962 and boundary F1 score of 0.8036.

articleTitle: Intelligent Brain Tumor Detection using Fine-Tuned EfficientNets
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Improving patient prognosis and treatment success is contingent upon timely and precise detection of brain tumors. Because Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) can create highly contrasted images of brain regions, it is a primary diagnostic technique. Recently, advancements in deep learning, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have significantly enhanced the capability to interpret these medical images. This paper proposes a novel approach employing a fine-tuning methodology with EfficientNets, specifically EfficientNetB3, for the classification of MRI brain images into four tumor categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and no tumor. The EfficientNetB3 model was selected for its balance between efficiency and accuracy in computational performance. Comparative analysis was conducted between the fine-tuned EfficientNetB3 and other pre-trained CNN models to evaluate its effectiveness in tumor detection. Superior performance was shown by the proposed EfficientNetB3-based brain tumor detector, which achieved an accuracy of 99.34%, F1-score of 99%, recall of 99%, and precision of 99%.

articleTitle: Synthesis and characterization of Nickel Aluminate-innovative a green path with solid acid catalyst for solvent free acylation reaction
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This study explores the development and application of a novel solid acid catalyst, mesoporous nickel aluminate, for the acylation of resorcinol. Solid acid catalysts are gaining significant traction in industrial organic synthesis due to their powerful acidic properties and heterogeneous nature, which eliminates the need for a separate neutralization step. The synthesized mesoporous nickel aluminate was comprehensively characterized. Subsequently, we evaluate the catalytic performance of the synthesized material in the acylation of resorcinol. The investigation optimizes reaction parameters such as solvent selection, temperature, and catalyst loading, with the detailed findings presented in this work.

articleTitle: Telugu Text Generation with LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Text generation refers to the process of automatically generating human-readable text, often using a natural language processing (NLP) model. An automatic text generation system predicts the next text based on the previous text(s). Many text generation models have been studied and developed for many world languages such as English, Chinese, Spanish, etc. Very little work is reported in text generation of Indian languages. In order to bridge this research gap, the present work aims to develop an automatic text generation system of a regional language namely Telugu. Our work explores a character-based text generation system using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) which is a neural network-based model. The model achieves an accuracy of 72.10%

articleTitle: A new Chaotic Jerk system based only on a Single quadratic equation displaying Coexisting attractors
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In this work an single quadratic differential equations based new chaotic jerk system is proposed. This new system governed orgin equilibrium point and two remaining equilibrium points with 3 contant variables that generates typical chaotic attractors and indicated coexisting attractors and basin attractions for the system dynamics based on initial conditions which was not reported elsewhere in literature. Furthermore, this can increase the encryption space in secure communication for the proposed chaotic system. Also, the proposed system dynamic analysis of this chaotic attractor are investigated by numerical methods using the Lyapunov spectrum and the new chaotic system complexity determined by the Kaplan-Yorke dimension of 2.16.

articleTitle: Analysing Depression in Social Media: A Study of Basic Deep Learning Algorithms and Transformer Model with a Comparative Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Depression is a psychological issue characterized by lingering feelings of despair, gloom, and a diminished engagement or pleasure in undertakings. It surpasses normal emotional fluctuations, casting a profound impact on an individual’s daily life. The rise of diverse messaging applications and online platforms has provided everyone with the means to easily express, share, and communicate their opinions, emotions, deepest thoughts, accomplishments and fears with the global audience. Every day, substantial volumes of text data are generated. Effectively handling the expanding text data requires the utilization of suitable tools. This study delves into the field of depression detection, exploring various methodologies that utilize advanced Deep Learning algorithms. The study focuses on utilizing data from internet forums to spot depression, taking into account the global occurrence and impact of depressive disorders. Notably, the research implements Deep Learning models, specifically RNN and Transformer variants, including GRU, LSTM, BiGRU, BiLSTM, and the Switch Transformer. Highlighting the importance of quickly identifying depression for effective intervention and treatment, the paper emphasizes the challenges and significance of analysing social media content for depression identification.
