The research seeks to contribute to mental healthcare by utilizing advanced Deep Learning models to attain optimal outcomes in identifying depression within social media.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of House Price Prediction Using Machine learning and Deep learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: It is always a dream for everyone to own a house or flat., House prices increase every year, so there is a need for a system to, predict house prices in the future. House price prediction system will, help the developer to determine the selling price of a house and also, help the customer to make correct decision to look for a suitable, property to purchase. Most of the buyers expect the house based on, budget, prime location, property type, size etc. This paper presents, a comparative study on house price prediction using three distinct, models that is Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Naive Bayes, and, Random Forest (RF). Through comparative analysis, we evaluate the, performance of these models on a real-world housing dataset. The, outcome of this research contributes to advancing the field of real, estate prediction models that utilize the advantages of models. These, methods improved accuracy and efficiency in predicting house, prices, aiding house owners for reselling, real estate professionals, and investors facilitating informed decision in the ever-changing, real estate market.

articleTitle: Smart Patrolling System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The implementation of Smart Patrolling System using IoT is to provide a safety to the people those who are present in the area by the help of fixing a Sound Sensor, Ultrasonic sensor, Raspberry pi, Node MCU, Night vision camera, GPS, GSM in street lights. The Smart Patrolling System using IoT continuously monitor the place and it gives the signal to the people those who are living in the place first then the control room. The proposed system can be used in Residential areas for giving better safety to the people. The proposed system gives a very most importance to Women and children safety. By the use of our proposed system several crime attacks can be found immediately and it can be avoided from crucial situations.

articleTitle: Modelling of Artificial Intelligence Based Eco-friendly Quadcopter for Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Quadcopter drones offer a new approach to environmental monitoring, offering advantages over traditional methods such as flexibility, cost-effectiveness, and high-resolution data collection. Quadcopter-based environmental sensing is a rapidly developing field with the potential to have a significant impact on a wide range of environmental monitoring applications. This paper reviews the state-of-the-art in quadcopter-based environmental sensing, including sensor integration, data collection and analysis, and applications. One of the key challenges is developing robust and reliable sensors that can be integrated into quadcopter drones. Another challenge is developing efficient and effective algorithms for collecting and analyzing environmental data from quadcopter drones. Future research focuses on developing robust sensors and efficient algorithms for quadcopter-based environmental sensing.

articleTitle: Integrative Framework for Heart Failure Risk Assessment and Tailored Mitigation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Heart failure is a major problem which affects many people across the world .The paper proposes an integrated architecture combining advanced predictive modeling for the risk assessment of heart failure and medication recommendations concerning metabolism-related factors. By using classification algorithms, including decision trees and gradient boosting, the paper aims at accurately predicting heart failure risk. Moreover, the model will suggest remedial actions concerning diabetes stabilization, creatinine levels, and anemia management, striving to provide a complete approach to the prevention of heart failure.

articleTitle: Ensemble Based Soil Classification Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: India's inhabitants rely heavily on agriculture for their livelihood. This research contributes significantly to the country's economy. Soil is essential for agriculture. An important component of agriculture is soil. There are different soil types. Different crops thrive on different types of soils, and different types of soil might have distinct properties. To know which crops grow best in certain types of soil, need to know the characteristics and characteristics of different typeso of soil. With in the domain domaagricultural data analysis, machine learning is a challenging research area that is still developing. In the suggested work, soil classification dataset are collected from kaggle are classified into black soil, cinder soil, Laterite soil, Peat soil and yellow soil. In the proposed work 70% were contemplated for training, 30% were used for testing. Extraction is done using Speeded Up Robust Features which ensembles exploiting Radial Basis Functional Neural Network and Gaussian Mixture Model by combining outcomes voting and boosting where voting gives the satisfactory results of 86%

articleTitle: Mental Health Harmony: Insights from the Machine Learning Frontier
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Detecting mental health problems at the earliest can help professionals provide correct treatment and increase the value of patients. One of the most prevalent types of impairment in the world is depression. It is important to deal adolescent mental health issues which can escalate to more serious problems if not addressed early. Machine learning techniques are ideal for estimating and diagnosing medical data. Feature selection techniques have been applied to the entire attribute dataset to reduce attributes. Machine Learning accuracy is associated with attributes from the dataset. Three algorithms are employed in this work, Logistic Regression, Random Forest Classifiers, and Decision Tree Classifiers, in data science techniques. Sensitivity and Specificity are measures that estimate a model’s capability to predict true positive and negative results. When these algorithms are compared the random forest classifier yields 95% accuracy when compared with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Investigation of Octagon-Slotted Photonic Crystal for Wireless Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In part of its ability to take on various shapes, the photonic antenna is highly regarded in wireless applications. In order to increase the antenna's effectiveness, a patch antenna with a square shape was built in this work using a variety of substrate materials. Due to the power being coupled into the surface wave by the substrate's high permittivity, efficiency is reduced, and the return loss is increased to address this issue. Due to the dielectric medium's frequency, this has arisen. Utilizing CST (computer simulation technology), microstrip patch antenna layout is carried out. The next step is to build an antenna using a thin the material graphene patch that is 3.4 mm in size. However the determined return loss of the planned antenna to operate connects at 1.174 THz.

articleTitle: Library Book Recommendation Chatbot Using Rasa NLU
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In response to the growing demand for streamlined library management, this project introduces an innovative system centered around a friendly and intuitive chatbot. The motivation behind this endeavor stems from the need for a cost-effective, personalized recommendation system tailored specifically to local library collections. By harnessing the power of Rasa NLU, a conversational agent was developed to seamlessly assist library visitors in discovering their next favorite read. Through a meticulous integration of Rasa NLU's capabilities, including custom actions for book and author inquiries and entity extraction for genres and descriptions, the chatbot effectively navigates user queries within the library's context. With a keen focus on precision and user engagement, the system's DIETClassifier ensures accurate intent recognition, facilitating seamless interaction and meaningful responses. The project outcomes underscore the chatbot's ability to understand nuanced requests, provide tailored book recommendations, and enhance user experience within library environments. This initiative serves as a testament to the transformative potential of open-source AI tools in enhancing public service offerings and fostering greater accessibility to library resources [1][2][6][8][12].

articleTitle: Gamifying Language Learning: Applying Augmented Reality and Gamification Strategies for Enhanced English Language Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In a time where interactive technology and digital innovations rule the roost, educators are always looking for new and creative ways to get students interested in learning and improve language acquisition. This study investigates how gamification techniques and augmented reality (AR) could be combined to transform English language instruction and create a captivating learning environment. With the growing ubiquity of digital technology, language learners may overcome obstacles and improve their English language skills by utilizing gamification and augmented reality. By establishing an interactive environment where students may interact with virtual components that are completely integrated into the actual world, the study explores the effects of augmented reality on language acquisition. Through the use of gamification concepts, including goal-setting, competition, and prizes, the study seeks to inspire students and cultivate a positive mindset toward language learning. Augmented reality and gamification work together to provide a personalized, dynamic learning environment that accommodates a range of learning preferences and styles. The study technique includes creating and deploying an augmented reality (AR) language learning application, then thoroughly evaluating its efficacy. Data, both quantitative and qualitative, will be collected to assess how language proficiency, user involvement, and general satisfaction have improved. The results are intended to provide insightful information on the effectiveness of this novel methodology, with implications for teachers, curriculum developers, and curriculum designers who want to improve language learning techniques. In the end, our research aims to close the gap that exists between conventional language learning techniques and the digital age, laying the groundwork for language education's future by fusing cutting-edge tools with successful teaching techniques.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Early Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease: Performance Evaluation and Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a major global public health issue, highlighting the importance of early detection to slow down its advancement. This study conducts a comparative analysis of machine learning algorithms aimed at early CKD detection, focusing on performance evaluation and insights into algorithmic efficacy. Leveraging diverse datasets encompassing clinical, demographic, and laboratory parameters, we evaluate the performance of various algorithms including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Results indicate substantial variations in predictive accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity across different algorithms. SVM demonstrates robust performance with high accuracy and sensitivity, while RF and GBM exhibit competitive results albeit with nuances in predictive characteristics. Additionally, CNN, leveraging deep learning techniques, showcases promising potential, especially in handling complex data structures. Insightful analysis of feature importance highlights significant clinical parameters contributing to predictive models, offering valuable insights into disease mechanisms and risk factors. This study provides a comprehensive overview of machine learning methodologies for early CKD detection, facilitating informed decision-making in clinical practice and paving the way for personalized healthcare interventions aimed at combating the CKD epidemic.

articleTitle: Z-Number and DEMATEL-Based Scheme to Enhance Energy-Efficient Workflow Scheduling and Virtual Machine Consolidation for Green Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Cloud computing and big data technologies are now experiencing significant global development, leading to the emergence of several data centres. Nevertheless, as the data centre building progresses, the issues of underutilization of server resources and excessive energy usage are becoming more apparent. In this regards a novel approach called Z-NUM-DEMATELs, which combines an Integrated Z-NUMBER and DEMATEL-based Cooperation Enforcement for VM consolidation, is proposed to achieve two main objectives: reducing energy consumption and enhancing resource utilisation. The recommended method emphasizes the software level by using the adaptability of virtualization technology via the implementation of migration strategies. A power efficient utilisation factor is added to identify the hosts that are not being fully used. The utilisation factor limits the number of migrations, which might result in increased energy usage. The proposed method's effectiveness in enhancing energy efficiency and resource utilisation is demonstrated through experimental verification on the CloudSim simulation platform. This is achieved through a comparative study against benchmark solutions, and the numerical results confirm the superiority of the proposed method over existing solutions.

articleTitle: Creating A Resilient Blockchain Framework To Enhance The Efficiency And Security Of Data Management Within Internet Of Things Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized the way devices interact and share information, creating a vast network of interconnected devices. Studyproposed a robust blockchain framework tailored for the unique requirements of IoT environments to address these challenges. The proposed blockchain framework aims to enhance data integrity, security, and efficiency in IoT networks by leveraging the decentralized and tamper-resistant nature of blockchain technology. By incorporating smart contracts, the framework enables autonomous and secure execution of predefined rules, ensuring transparent and trustworthy interactions among IoT devices. The use of consensus algorithms specific to IoT requirements enhances the efficiency of data validation and ensures timely and accurate information dissemination. Furthermore, the framework focuses on scalability to accommodate the growing number of devices in IoT networks without compromising performance. Through the integration of consensus mechanisms and optimized data structures, the proposed solution minimizes the computational overhead associated with blockchain operations in resource-constrained IoT devices. By enhancing security, efficiency, and scalability, the study establishes the development of resilient and trustworthy IoT ecosystems, fostering innovation and growth in the rapidly evolving landscape of interconnected devices. The scalability index of the proposed method is 98.12% when compared with existing methods like ripple, DPOS and tendermint.

articleTitle: Navigating the Nexus: A Bibliometric Analysis of the Intersection Between AI, Multimedia and Journalism
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in media and journalism is a rapidly evolving area that is reshaping the landscape of news production, distribution, and consumption . [7] However, the full potential of AI in journalism is currently limited by the reliance on tech companies and the early stages of academic literature on the topic. Studies highlight the transformative impact of AI on journalism, emphasizing its role in enabling journalists to break news quickly while also facilitating in-depth analysis. The integration of AI in media and Journalism is evolving drastically, reshaping the landscape of production, distribution and consumption of news content. AI technologies, such as machine learning, planning and optimization are increasingly used in the news industry to enhance productivity and efficiency. This study "Navigating the Nexus: A Bibliometric Analysis of the Intersection Between AI, Multimedia and Journalism" provides a comprehensive overview of the research data over the time period of 2015 to 2024 comprising 73 scholarly documents from 40 different sources to explore the intersection of AI in media and Journalism to increase the productivity and efficiency of news and content production. The study underlines the importance of AI in enhancing the journalistic capabilities while addressing the challenges of the implementation. This study aims at the annual publication numbers in the given time span. Major themes include the implementation of AI in journalism, ethical considerations on AI in news production, global impact, the future research directions to ensure it fulfils humanity’s best interests without enhancing societal inequalities or biases.

articleTitle: Detecting E-Bullying in Social Media Platform with Stacked BiLSTM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Nowadays, E-bullying is a widespread phenomenon faced by people in the digital realm and has been escalating rapidly. E-bullying poses a significant threat to individual’s well-being and mental health that can even lead to suicide attempts. Detecting and addressing such behavior on social media platforms is crucial in ensuring a safe and supportive online environment. The Stacked BiLSTM architecture is presented for identifying E-bullying. The methodology encompasses data collection from Kaggle, followed by data cleaning, and preprocessing techniques to ensure dataset quality. Subsequently, the deep learning model is trained using TensorFlow and Keras libraries, leveraging the bidirectional processing and hierarchical representation learning capabilities of Stacked BiLSTM networks. The model’s effective-ness is assessed on a balanced dataset of 4000 texts, yielding a learning accuracy of 88.7% and an assessment accuracy of 82.2%. Result analysis underscores the efficacy of SBiLSTM to identify e-bullying, indicating potential for the development of improved detection systems. Overall, the proposed approach contributes to mitigating online harassment and fostering safer digital environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Android Malware Detection Through Machine Learning: Insights From Permission and Metadata Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The spread of the Android ecosystem has increased potentially harmful applications, which present a serious cybersecurity threat. According to reports, a significant percentage of applications housed on the Play Store (10–24%) may behave maliciously, hiding their evil intentions behind a facade of legitimacy. The present methods for detecting malware, which are frequently resource-intensive and slow to adjust to new threats, have limits when it comes to solving this growing problem. By carefully examining data on verified dangerous applications and developing a predictive model that can reliably identify malicious applications based on the permissions they request, this study seeks to address these issues. The paper also presents a novel method for creating a machine learning-based detection model using publicly accessible metadata. With an emphasis on Android malware detection, the main goal of this study is to create a reliable model that can classify applications as malicious (1) or benign (0) depending on the permissions they request. The main activities involve a thorough examination of Android permissions and metadata as critical markers for detecting any malware, as well as the development and evaluation of a machine-learning model using publicly available metadata. In the end, initiative aims to strategically apply machine learning techniques to lessen the growing threat of Android malware. This research aims to offer a strong and proactive solution to preventing the spread of harmful programs through careful analysis and the creation of an efficient model.

articleTitle: Sign Language Detecting System Using Tensorflow Object Detection API
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Communication is the only way we can communicate or express ourselves, but for those with disabilities like deafness and neuropathy face challenges in communicating with others. To enhance communication between deaf individuals and regular people, we developed a sign language detection system that employs TensorFlow's object detection capabilities to enable real-time translation of sign Language gestures. Primarily hand gestures are obtained from the deaf and hard-of-hearing people and then compared with the data set. The data set formerly consist of n number of gesture gesticulations which are already labeled and stored with the help of Single Shot MultiboxDetector (SSD) concept. Once the features of an incoming image are paralleled with features of formerly labeled images in a data set, it indicates recognition of gesture. Eventually, the gesture is translated into the message. The accessibility of communication was improved by this sign language detecting system. This assistive technology can be utilized in future applications due to its precise and efficient real time sign language detection. It provides a real-time means of converting hand movements into text

articleTitle: Implementing OTP Verification and Zero Trust Security for Role-Based Access Control in Medical Records
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This paper proposes a comprehensive approach for enhancing security in medical record systems by incorporating One-Time Password (OTP) verification and Zero Trust Security principles within a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) framework. With the increasing digitization of medical records and the growing threat of cyberattacks, ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability of patient information is paramount. OTP verification adds a layer of authentication, mitigating the risk of unauthorized access even in the event of compromised credentials. Integrating Zero Trust Security principles ensures that access permissions are continuously evaluated and verified based on various contextual factors, such as device health, user behavior, and network location, rather than relying solely on static credentials. Furthermore, RBAC facilitates granular access control, allowing administrators to assign roles and permissions based on users' responsibilities and organizational hierarchy. By combining OTP verification, Zero Trust Security, and RBAC, healthcare organizations can establish a robust security framework that minimizes the risk of data breaches and ensures compliance with regulatory requirements such as HIPAA.

articleTitle: End To End Comments Filtering Feature Using Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: In the age of digital communication, social media platforms have become essential tools for interaction and information sharing worldwide. However, these platforms often face the challenge of managing negative and harsh comments, which threaten to disrupt a healthy online environment. This paper presents an innovative end-to-end comments filtering feature that uses sentiment analysis to detect and mitigate such undesirable comments. The proposed system employs advanced Multilingual Sentiment Analysis techniques using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and the Naive Bayes Classifier to analyze comments in Tamil, Tanglish (a blend of Tamil and English), and English.Once negative comments are identified, the system filters and deletes them, sends warning emails to offending users, and blocks repeat offenders. This approach not only curtails harmful content but also discourages users from posting negative comments in the future. Experimental results demonstrate the system's effectiveness in significantly reducing negative comments and maintaining a positive online community. The combination of LSTM networks and Naive Bayes Classifier provides a robust framework for sentiment analysis and automated moderation, paving the way for healthier social media environments.

articleTitle: Exploring the intricacies of Biometric ATM operations, specifically focusing on the integration of fingerprint and facial recognition using Deep Learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: India’s technological advancements have significantly enhanced convenience and reliability in the banking sector, benefiting consumers with notable progress. ATMs have revolutionized transaction processes, reducing the chances of errors by human intervention. Despite these advantages, incidents of card theft and fraudulent transactions have been on the rise, posing challenges to the security and trustworthiness of ATMs. Transitioning to person-based identification during transactions is crucial to bolster security measures. The adoption of a biometric authentication system is imperative for ensuring user verification through a virtual ATM approach, utilizing face and fingerprint recognition technologies, live streaming, Channel Boosted Convolutional Neural Networks, and One Time Password implementation to establish a highly secure and dependable virtual ATM system. Further research will delve into the details of this proposed strategy.

Author Keywords: Enhanced Convolutional Neural Networks through Channel Boosting

articleTitle: Deciphering Key Genes in Colon Cancer Through Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Identification and prognostication of colon cancer hold pivotal significance for biomedical research studies. Cancer is a genetically related disease in which defective genes are prone to making changes in expression. So, detecting colon cancer at an early stage can contribute to increasing patient survival rates. In recent years, computer-aided diagnosis systems utilizing Deep Learning techniques have emerged for the accurate diagnosis of colon cancer in the healthcare sector. In this methodology, microarray analysis is utilized to reveal the characteristics of normal and diseased genes. In the research work, high-dimensional microarray colon cancer data are utilized to detect the cancer disease. The primary function of the research work is to develop a model using Deep Learning techniques to identify key genes associated with colon cancer and predict the disease. An unsupervised Autoassociator Dimensionality Reduction Technique (ADRT), is applied to identify significant biomarker genes while filtering out redundant and noisy genes present in the gene data. To predict colon cancer, Deep Neural Network classifier is utilized on the selected genes and the classifier’s performance is calculated using evaluation metrics. Finally, comparative analyses are performed before and after applying the dimensionality reduction technique. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the research model after applying ADRT, significantly improves the detection analysis in terms of minimizing the dimensionality of the gene data and increasing the accuracy value. Moreover, the research model can be smoothly integrated into medical healthcare systems, facilitating the precise diagnosis of Colon cancer.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Prediction in E-Commerce: Leveraging Vampire Bat Optimization and Factor Analysis for Enhanced Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: E-commerce platforms face various financial risks due to the dynamic and unpredictable nature of online markets. Predicting and managing these risks is essential for sustainable growth and profitability. This research proposes a novel approach for financial risk prediction in e-commerce by integrating Vampire Bat Optimization (VBO) and Factor Analysis (FA) to enhance decision-making processes. The Vampire Bat Optimization algorithm, inspired by the foraging behavior of vampire bats, is employed for feature selection and optimization. It efficiently identifies the most relevant financial factors affecting e-commerce risk prediction. Factor Analysis is then applied to extract the underlying latent variables from the selected features, reducing dimensionality and enhancing the model's interpretability. The proposed approach was evaluated using a comprehensive dataset obtained from a leading e-commerce platform. Various financial factors including sales volume, customer demographics, market trends, and economic indicators were considered. Furthermore, the interpretability of the model is enhanced through the identification of key risk factors, providing valuable insights for decision-makers. The proposed framework can assist e-commerce businesses in making informed decisions to mitigate financial risks, optimize resource allocation, and improve overall performance. The research contributes to the existing literature by providing a novel and effective solution for financial risk prediction in the e-commerce domain, thereby fostering sustainable growth and stability in online businesses. The VBO-FA model achieves an accuracy of 98% in classification tasks, demonstrating exceptional performance was implemented in Python.

articleTitle: Data Mining Framework for Discovering and Clustering Phenotypes of Atypical Diabetic Lung
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The global diabetes epidemic has exposed significant clinical variability in diabetic patients, including phenotypes that defy accepted characteristics. Atypical diabetic phenotypes in lungs are sifting through numerous data sets to establish connections and identify patterns to use data analysis to solve a certain issue. This article presents the Data Mining Framework based on the Atypical Diabetes Prediction Model (DMFADPM), built on the Data Mining Framework to identify and group the characteristics of A.D. in lungs. Data Mining Framework is used to solve the main problems of improving the prediction model's accuracy and enabling the model's adaptation to multiple datasets. The exclusion and inclusion processes are the two components of the preprocessing steps that form the foundation of the data mining technique. The experimental analysis of the proposed method has obtained an accuracy of 98.9%, prediction ratio of 0.22%, gain ratio of 95%, information gain of 92%.

articleTitle: Addressing Bias in Text-to-Image Generation: A Review of Mitigation Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Although text-to-image algorithms are quite good at converting text to images, they may use biased training data. This study looks into several definitions of bias and methods for calculating and mitigating it in models that convert text to images. We evaluate previous research on gender, skin tone, and geo-cultural bias in this survey. It shows the positive and negative aspects of different methods for evaluation and mitigation of bias. We discovered that: (1) To prevent misunderstandings when talking about "bias," it is crucial to make sure that definitions of bias are based on societal harms and to recognize the similarities and differences across suggested definitions; (2) Different sets of handmade prompts are commonly used, but there are no common assessment frameworks or metrics, and there are no unifying criteria for evaluation; and (3) It is necessary to conduct an extensive study to find bias mitigation methods to provide fair images because current mitigation techniques are unable to completely address biases. We identify future research directions that support precise definitions, evaluations, and mitigation of bias based on the present constraints. By highlighting the significance of researching biases in T2I systems, we want to inspire more research into the comprehensive understanding and management of biases, with the ultimate goal of creating equitable and reliable T2I technologies for all.

articleTitle: Optimized Convolutional Neural Network Model for Software Effort Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Optimized Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) designed as a useful tool for approximating and forecasting software effort. Convolutional Neural Networks, a subfield of machine learning, are utilized in estimate due to its propensity for quick learning and higher-quality, more accurate output. Using the effort estimation while also determining the most straightforward Convolutional neural network architecture for optimal learning. Additionally, a range of machines, such as convolutional neural networks, decision trees, random forests, principal component regression and support vector machines, are utilized to determine which model performs best in terms of software effort estimation. This experiment made use of the JM1 dataset. The metrics under discussion are evaluated using the following measures: Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), R-squared and Pred (25). Convolutional Neural Networks are the best models in this technique, as demonstrated by the results when compared to other models. Estimating software effort is used to project planning and resource allocation and project management as a whole estimation. Conventional models used for estimate techniques have limited accuracy and flexibility since they frequently rely on old data and judgment.

articleTitle: Empowering Coders: Revolutionizing Programming Education with NLP and Challenge-Based Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: "Empowering Coders" is a revolutionary web application that revolutionizes programming education by skillfully fusing sophisticated natural language processing (NLP) techniques with challenge-based learning. By providing a user-centric approach that includes registration, identification, and a carefully curated library of Python, Java, and C problem-solving problems, this platform transforms coding proficiency. Users select tasks based on language choices and skill levels as they set off on an adapted coding journey. The platform employs natural language processing (NLP) to thoroughly evaluate user submissions and furnish prompt, context-sensitive replies. Remarkable solutions add to a user's grade, providing a measurable indicator of development and proficiency. By easily adding new questions, administrators contribute significantly to the platform's enrichment and guarantee a dynamic and varied learning environment. By incorporating NLP approaches, the user experience is improved and coding education becomes both interactive and customizable to meet the needs of each learner.

articleTitle: Hybrid Fuzzy Logic interface PI Controller (HFLPIC) to enhance Power conversion efficiency in an Autonomous Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: If managed properly, Microgrids (MG) are autonomous, deregulated, and environmentally sustainable. Additionally, they reduce the load on the utility grid. However, given that they depend on unplanned environmental factors, these systems have an unstable generation capacity. Central power system failures have persisted as a result of the microgrids' instability. This paper aims to design and develop the integration of a hybrid fuzzy logic interface PI controller with a Z-source inverter (ZSI) using Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) technique to enhance power conversion efficiency in Autonomous Microgrid systems. The ZSI, with its unique impedance network, mitigates voltage sags and swells, improving grid reliability. The Hybrid Fuzzy logic interface PI Controller (HFLPIC) dynamically adjusts controller gains based on operating conditions, enhancing transient response and steady-state performance. The SVPWM technique minimizes harmonic distortion and switching losses, further improving system efficiency. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed system, showcasing regulated output voltage and Total Harmonic Distortion (THD). The integration of these techniques offers a promising solution for efficient power conversion, improved power quality, and reliable operation in Autonomous Microgrid applications.

Author Keywords: Smart grid (SG). MG/SG Infrastructure. Control methodologies. Hybrid Fuzzy logic-PI controller (HFLPIC)

articleTitle: Parsed Region Feature Extraction Method for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Detection Using Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma detection using medical images relies on precise feature selection from the set of extracted ones that augments high detection accuracy. This article introduces a Parsed Region Feature Extraction Method (PRFEM) to improve the carcinoma detection accuracy from medial input images. The proposed method utilizes a two-layer convoluted neural network with a linear pooling function to select optimal features for detection. The first layer is responsible for selecting visual pattern-based features that improve the region detection. In the second layer, the identified features are verified for their missing distribution sequences that are useful in retaining precision. The linear pooling identifies the distribution break points to train the CNN with the need for high feature selection. This improves the detection precision with minimum errors. The proposed PRFEM improves detection precision, feature selection, and accuracy by 11.7%, 9.4%, and 10.5% respectively for the varying patterns.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Maritime Security by Leveraging Advanced AIS Analytics for Precision Detection and Monitoring of Boats in Ocean
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The enormous oceans of today are the worldwide arteries of commerce and transportation, making maritime security an issue of fundamental importance. The issue at stake is that conventional approaches of identifying and tracking ships at sea often fail to keep up with the ever-changing conditions of the ocean. These restrictions threaten international commerce, security, and ecological equilibrium by making countries more vulnerable to things like piracy, smuggling, illicit fishing, and pollution. Automatic Identification System (AIS) analytics are strengthened by a range of state-of-the-art machine learning and deep learning algorithms in our "Next-Gen Maritime Security" solution. Through the use of these methods, we are able to improve vessel identification, trajectory prediction, behavior grouping, vessel type classification, and anomaly detection. By doing so, we are able to prevent potential threats to maritime security from occurring, therefore protecting international shipping lanes, maritime workers, and marine ecosystems. Our novel strategy provides a solid answer to the problem of marine security in today's dynamic environment.

articleTitle: Real-time Tool Defect Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: To support the competition and to produce industrial economically, it seems mostly that manufacturing systems must exhibit a high level of disgruntlement in their operation. Hence, to create such flexibility and thereby develop a Flexible Manufacturing System (FMS), it is necessary to reduce the human intervention in production. Flexibility in manufacturing can be understood and applicable through various standards & interpretations. In this work, the defects in the tools will be analyzed using image processing tools could exploit defects in the tool at a flexible manufacturing environment. Information from the installed sensors on vibration, acoustic emissions, spindle speed and cutting force in machine can be employed together to infer indirectly about tool flaws; portions or position referenced for correspondence mapping thus locating areas of interest. This information is primarily obtained through sensors, and upon processing this data it gives us some insight as to how the tool functions abnormally or where potential defects may be. A more direct approach is the non-contact cutting tool monitoring especially that which typically relies on vision images using optical inspection. This is because using this method, tool defects can be accurately described by size and position. It is possible to use digital image processing technologies to enhance the precision of the inspection and identification of the cutting tool’s condition. Besides making the methodology less rigid, it improves the reliability of cutting tool damage, workpiece defects, and tool positioning. In this case, the inspection process is aided by the DIP in providing extensive visual information concerning the condition of the tool. When it comes to this technology method, real-time control and quick decisions are provided and the dependence on people is significantly reduced, increasing versatility and manufacturing system performance. Therefore, the development of competitive and genuinely versatile production settings entails the incorporation of such advanced monitoring approaches.

articleTitle: Enhanced Image Processing for Automobile Accident Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Road safety can be creatively increased by utilizing systems for reporting and detecting accidents use the YOLO algorithm. Yolo, which stands for "You Only Look Once," is a sophisticated object recognition system that can identify and pinpoint objects in live video streams. By identifying accidents and notifying emergency services, the system lowers the reaction times and increases the possibility of saving lives by utilizing the YOLO algorithm. The object detection and alarm systems are the two primary parts of the proposed system. The YOLO method is employed by the object recognition module to look for accidents in live video broadcasts. A module of accident photos was used to teach the system to accurately identify incidents. When an accident is discovered, an alert system is activated. The location of the accident and a brief account of what transpired are communicated to the emergency services by the alert system. This information is communicated to emergency services through a wireless communication network, which expedites response times and increases the likelihood of saving lives. Positive results were obtained by testing the system using the images and an accident module. It was shown that the warning system could react in a couple of seconds and that the YOLO algorithm could identify accidents having a precision of around 94. Highways, busy intersections, and other high-risk areas may have systems in place to increase traffic safety and lower the number of accidents. Developing crash detection and warning systems using deep learning using the YOLO technique is one way to potentially increase road safety. With the use of technology, problems may be precisely identified in real-time video feeds, alerting emergency services and potentially increasing survival rates and reaction times.

articleTitle: Unified Payment Interface Imposture and Scam Detection Using Deep Learning And ANN
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The Unified Payment Interface (UPI) has revolutionized digital payments in India, providing a convenient and secure way for individuals to transfer funds. However, the increasing popularity of UPI has also attracted malicious actors engaging in imposture and scams to defraud users. A novel approach is proposed to detect UPI imposture and scams using Deep Learning and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). This system leverages the power of deep learning techniques, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), to analyze transaction data and user behavior patterns. A comprehensive dataset is collected and preprocessed, containing legitimate UPI transactions as well as historical data associated with known scams and imposture cases. By training the model on this dataset, it learns to identify suspicious patterns and anomalies in real-time transactions.

articleTitle: Smart Truck Load Monitoring and Overload Prevention System with Ignition and Fuel Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The Smart Truck Load Monitoring and Overload Prevention System with Ignition and Fuel Control is a comprehensive solution that tackles important issues facing the trucking sector. Truck transportation is essential for moving products over long distances in the modern global economy. Effective cargo load management does, however, provide several challenges, such as adhering to weight regulations, optimizing fuel use, and maintaining environmental sustainability. By creating an integrated system that combines cutting-edge sensor technologies, microcontroller systems, and communication networks, this research aims to address these issues. Load monitoring sensors, such as load cells and amplifiers, which precisely measure truck loads in real time, are at the heart of the system. As the system’s brains, the NodeMCU-ESP8266 microcontroller processes load data and plan system actions. The seamless integration of mobile devices and onboard technologies enables fleet managers and truck operators to get real-time warnings and monitoring, resulting in improved safety, efficiency, and sustainability in transportation operations.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on the Advances and Challenges in Visible Light Communication Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Visible Light Communication (VLC) is a burgeoning technology leveraging Light-Emitting Diodes (LEDs) to transmit data through modulating light, achieving speed imperceptible to the human eye. This technology offers an optimistic alternative to traditional Radio Frequency (RF) communication due to its high bandwidth, energy efficiency, and security advantages. VLC utilizes the visible light spectrum, which is abundant and free from electromagnetic interference, making it an ideal solution for indoor communication environments. This survey article provides a comprehensive overview of VLC, starting from its fundamental principles to the latest advancements and applications. It begins with a discussion on the characteristics of visible light and its advantages over RF communication, including the ability to use existing lighting infrastructure for data transmission. The article then elaborates on the technical aspects of VLC, including modulation techniques, data rate enhancements, and the integration of VLC with existing communication technologies. Challenges such as light interference, indoor and outdoor propagation models, and device compatibility are also critically analyzed. Further, the article explores various applications of VLC in real-world scenarios, such as in smart lighting, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, vehicle-to-vehicle communication, and underwater communication. It highlights the potential of VLC to revolutionize communication in sectors where RF communication is limited or impractical. In conclusion, this comprehensive study highlights the significant potential of VLC technology, while also acknowledging the limitations that needs to be overcomes for its widespread adoption. Keywords— VLC (Visible Light Communication), LED (Light Emitting Diode), RF (Radio Frequency), ML (Machine Learning), DL (Deep Learning).

articleTitle: Data Security in Cloud Computing Using Maritime Search and Rescue Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Cloud computing has fundamentally transformed the accessibility and payment models of services within distributed system environments. In response to heightened security concerns, cloud service providers offer diverse resources spanning Infrastructure, Software, Platform, and Database services, supported by security measures such as Service Level Agreements (SLAs), access control rules, and cryptographic methods. This paper introduces a novel data encryption technique, termed Data Security in Cloud Computing using Maritime Search and Rescue Algorithm (DSCC-MSRA). By integrating an enhanced cypher block chaining algorithm with logical substitution and the Maritime Search and Rescue Algorithm (MSRA) for key generation, this method provides a unique approach to encryption. Through rigorous optimization and analysis, it has undergone significant refinement, with comparisons against industry-standard algorithms showcasing its efficacy. The primary objective is to elevate encryption procedures and introduce complexity to cryptanalysis, ultimately enhancing data security in cloud computing.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Start-up Success Rate Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Software startups create innovative products or services using programming, which can lead to a need for products from potential customers. Researchers suggest that trial and error methodology can increase the success rate of these organizations by evaluating assumptions about client needs before fostering a product. However, programming new businesses typically do not require trial and error. The study aims to predict the success of startup companies in their early development stages by analyzing their success based on initial funding. A study of 106 unsuccessful software start-ups was conducted to predict the success rate. The experimentation progression model (X Pro) was developed to show that effective experimentation requires understanding trial and error, setting objectives, conducting tests, analyzing results, and acting based on new knowledge. The findings provide insights into supporting procedures and approaches that enhance trial- and-error reception in developing new business models. Researchers can become aware of potential factors leading to startup disappointment and take precautions to avoid them. The research focuses on using web-based open sources, including social networking services and the web, to model the task. The study uses machine learning techniques like Random Forest, Gradient Boost Classifier, XG Boost, and Ada Boost Classifier. The analysis provides insights into the types of useful signals discovered on the web and market mechanisms underlying the funding process. This approach offers a more comprehensive approach to predicting startup success.

articleTitle: Hybrid Spotted Hyena and Simulated Annealing Optimization Algorithm(HSHOSAA-1) for Efficient Task Scheduling in a Clustered Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Efficient task scheduling in the cloud is vital as it maximises the utilisation of resources, guaranteeing optimal allocation of computing resources such as CPU and memory. It improves the efficiency of the system by reducing the amount of time it spends idle and maximising the amount of work that can be done by applications and services. This article presents a new way for optimization algorithms by combining two approaches: the Spotted Hyena Optimisation algorithm (SHO) and the Simulated Annealing algorithm (SA). SHO utilises the cooperative hunting behaviours of hyenas to investigate the issue space and discover the most efficient or nearly perfect solutions for optimising job scheduling. SA enhances SHO by repeatedly refining solutions, resulting in increased convergence rates and attaining superior task scheduling results. The problem involves the selection of appropriate virtual machines (VMs) and the allocation of executors (resources), like a Bin Packing problem, which is a computationally difficult optimization work known as NP-Hard. The objective of our proposed HSHOSA-1 is to evaluate the requirements of tasks and the resources that are available for task scheduling. The main goal is to optimize task scheduling by minimizing expenses, preventing virtual machine overload, and ensuring balanced resource utilization. By conducting simulations on the CloudSim platform, the experimental findings show that the approach effectively decreases the number of virtual machines (VMs) needed to deploy all executors. This methodology efficiently reduces the total expenditure on resources in comparison to conventional scheduling strategies.

articleTitle: Classification of Alzheimer’s Disease with Generated MRI Images using Randomized CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is identified by the presence of aberrant brain structures, called plaques and tangles, which interfere with intercellular communication and lead to cognitive decline and behavioral changes. It is imperative to identify Alzheimer's disease early on, before it manifests clinically, since treatment success is greatly increased by intervention during the early stages. In this work, a unique approach is employed to generate synthetic images using cycle generative adversarial network (cycleGAN) to expand a labeled dataset of medical images. The cycleGAN is trained on unpaired data to learn the mapping between different domains, and cycle consistency losses are utilized to ensure accurate image translation. By integrating the generated images with the publicly available dataset, a randomized convolutional neural network (CNN), which uses random activation functions, is trained to classify the data into four distinct stages of Alzheimer's disease. The classification accuracy achieved using the randomized CNN is an impressive 97.84%, demonstrating the effectiveness of this method in enhancing dataset size and improving classification performance. With 97.39% accuracy for cases of mild dementia and 99.4% accuracy for cases of very mild dementia, the model contributes significantly to the fight against Alzheimer's and shows promise in early identification of the disease.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Excellence: A Comparative Study of Amazon and Flipkart
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: This study aims to do a comprehensive comparative examination of the complex supply chain management frameworks that are used by Amazon and Flipkart, two of the biggest online retailers. Supply chain excellence is emphasized heavily in the inquiry, which examines important aspects including inventory control, fulfillment processes, technology integration, and customer-centric strategies. Through a thorough analysis and comparison of the many supply chain methods that Amazon and Flipkart have used, this research seeks to clarify the distinctive operational effectiveness, creative approaches, and possible areas for improvement in each of their supply chain ecosystems. Not only do the findings clarify the subtle nuances of supply chain dynamics in the e-commerce space, but they also have important ramifications for practitioners, scholars, and industry participants who are trying to make their way through the changing terrain of contemporary supply chain management.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy and Performance in Wireless Sensor Networks for IoT Applications Using CR-MSGT, SDN, and Gaussian Filters
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: The monitoring of physical conditions in a variety of contexts is greatly aided by Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Regarding energy consumption and network performance, WSNs depend on efficient routing methods for data transfer. By comparing the CR-MSGT approach’s performance to other routing protocols, this study assesses the energy efficiency of WSNs. Proactive, reactive, and hybrid protocols are among the categories of routing protocols that are examined, depending on how they operate and the applications for which they are intended. Together with data-centric, hierarchical, and location-based techniques, the research also examines direct communication, flat, and clustering protocols. Specialized transducers with restricted power and capacity for storage are grouped by WSN to offer detecting services to the Internet of Things devices. Findings point to the potential of CR-MSGT for increasing network scalability and optimizing energy use. Research findings help to improve WSN performance in Internet of Things applications.

articleTitle: EHR based Prediction and Diet Recommender For Diabetes using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Diabetes is an illness which is triggered due to high blood sugar levels. Ignoring diabetes is undesirable since the condition can have adverse impacts on the heart, kidneys, cholesterol levels, eyes, and almost all other organs. Diabetes will be easier to manage the earlier it is detected. To do this, researchers use a variety of machine learning techniques to more accurately forecast the onset of early diabetes in human bodies or in its patients. By constructing models using datasets that are available, machine learning techniques produce more accurate predictions. In the proposed work, Random Forest Algorithm is used to predict diabetes, as this technique outperforms in terms of accuracy. Individuals with diabetes, maintaining an appropriate diet is crucial. The majority of them aim to assist users in managing their blood sugar levels. A person’s weekly meal preparation habits can be attributed to a myriad of intersecting elements, such as taste, healthfulness, financial constraints, personal preferences, and lifestyle. An individual might experience it difficult to choose what to eat. To assist with the management of diabetes, the proposed system advises using a customized meal planning strategy. The diet plan suggested in the system is based on decision tree technique which is diabetic-friendly that is also socially, economically, and culturally acceptable and that can satisfy all nutritional needs while being mindful of calories. Following the prediction of diabetes and the suggestion of a diet plan, the patient’s medical information is stored in the EHR for convenient access.

articleTitle: Automatic Android Malware Detection using CNN and GRU
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies and Systems for Next Generation Computing (ICSTSN)
abstract: Strong methods for its identification and mitigation are required due to the serious threat that Android malware poses to user security and privacy. Address this important issue by introducing a new method of combating Android malware via static analysis. To automate the detection process, our approach uses a hybrid deep learning architecture that combines Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). This paper presents a system that is specifically intended to target several types of malware, such as banking malware, riskware, adware, and SMS malware, while also differentiating between safe apps. Improving the model’s accuracy and robustness is essential to its overall functionality. It starts our investigation by creating a balanced, well-categorized dataset that includes the many previously discussed categories. The methodology consists of preprocessing and gathering datasets, extracting features, and combining CNN and GRU components. While the GRU component processes the series of API calls and records temporal dependencies and patterns of behavior across time, the CNN component records spatial patterns inside static code representations. Using suitable loss functions and optimization strategies, we provide comprehensive insights into the CNN + GRU model’s training and validation on the categorized dataset. A variety of criteria, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, are used to assess performance for each category of malicious and benign apps. The outcomes of our thorough testing show how well our suggested approach detects Android malware, providing a viable way to improve device security in the face of the growing threat posed by Android malware.
